pid.description: The process ID or name of the process to monitor. If a name is given, pagemon monitors the first matching process.

delay.description: Delay in microseconds between data refreshes.

zoom.description: Default zoom level on page view. Higher values increase the zoom level so more pages are represented.

ticks.description: Ticks between dirty page checks. Larger values mean longer time between checks.

auto_zoom.description: Enable automatic zoom mode to show the entire page map.

read_pages.description: Force all pages in the process to be read into physical memory.
